strings.en: Hurry!
There's no telling how much energy a collapsing planet will release!
Winging it from start to finish, huh!?
Hey, Hazuki, this is gonna work, right!?
...Who knows.
Ruri, can you calculate it...?
...It might be better not to ask. Besides, it's only a probability...
Hey, the way you say that makes me super nervous...
In the worst case, it might affect not just us, but Earth as well.
D-Don't scare me! Not after coming this far!
The chance isn't zero... All that's left is to pray.
The worst case is if we can't stop this asteroid, right?
Either way, it's over.
That's why all we can do is pray, right?
That this planet breaks apart and we come out of it okay.
That's way too convenient.
Rokkon shojo, rokkon shojo...
Is that supposed to be a prayer...?
Dammit, if it gets us out of here safe, I'll pray, dance,
whatever it takes!
The fighting's far from over. We need that kind of spirit.
Prayer...? As long as I live, I'll carve my path by my own strength!
That's right, we're not burning out in a place like this!
I-It's that dangerous!? ...C-Can't we just not, Show?
Too late now. If anything happens, we're counting on the Aura Barrier.
But... if we're caught in the planet's explosion...
Even Tobikage can't help against an explosion, huh. Oh well...!
Hey, hey! He's gonna pick us up, right!?
Captain Bright, I mean!
The Ra Cailum should be waiting in orbit.
As long as it's not caught in the blast, we'll be fine.
Captain Bright can be surprisingly scatterbrained, though...
Will it really be okay?
...That's harsh.
Surely not... Well, I can't say for sure.
Aww, poor Captain.
No time for idle chatter. The Gandor's... reaching the core...!
The Gandor is arriving!
...We're... out of time...!
Full power! Don't think about what comes after, just give it everything!
Kenrou, protect us...!
...The Dirad's... long-cherished wish... burns... Once again... unfulfilled...
Why... why...! 200 million years ago... then it was... too soon...!
Now that life fills this universe... surely now... is the time...!
...Same...
Same... Result... Will be... Unchanged...
Like Earthlings...? No... We Dirad love only the peace of plants...!
Same... Because... The Beginning... Was the Same...
Earth...!?
Gyaaaaaaaah!
Ooh! Quickly, retreat at once! We'll be caught in the flames of the blast!
Retreat! Retreeeat!
Contact Charm and that Ilbora!
...I can't get through! Interference from that asteroid is jamming us...!
...Ilbora, that fool... He never could master the Zerokage here...!
To think my plan to watch over him directly would backfire like this...!
Your Majesty!
We withdraw from here. Set course for the Shema system at once...
It's no use, we won't make it in ti...
What...!? N-Nuwoooooh!
Is it over...?
Looks like the only big explosion was the first one.
Commander Hazuki, the observation results are in.
...With the planet's shrinking, and the orbit change from its loss of mass...
it's definitely going to miss its collision course with Earth!
Whew... For a while there I didn't know what was gonna happen.
Yeah, we pulled it off somehow.
So now it just burns itself out, huh?
It's like a little sun. Not that it'll last long.
Aw, after all that work, it'd feel way better if it blew up big and flashy!
I can see where you're coming from. ...Well, it worked out in the end.
Seriously, after all that panicked running away, I feel kinda cheated.
You've got that backwards.
It's because that didn't happen that we're safe. We should be grateful.
Whew... That took years off my life.
So... Commander, we're heading to the Ra Cailum next, right?
That's right. Shiba, contact Captain Bright and send him our coordinates.
Roger.
I sure hope he's not burning up over there too, Captain Bright.
Roasted?
...Who knows.
C'mon, Captain...
...Is Captain Bright really that much of a problem?
Hehe, isn't it more that they trust him, Shiro?
If we're talking problems, our Commander Hazuki's no slouch either.
Hey now, Mister.
Storming Hyakki Island, blowing up the Gandor this time...
I see... Then I have to work hard to become a problem person too!
The captain at the center of the storm! Ooh, doesn't that sound nice?
Yurika... you're putting your effort in the wrong direction...
...Whew. A crew this big will keep us both busy, eh, Captain Bright?
Who'd have thought... that plant planet would go up in flames.
Let's see, the recorded footage... Ah! This is...
...Emperor Annex's... Terahertz!? What's he doing there?
If he stays there he'll get caught in... Aaah! ...It blew up...
(...That vixen Charm saying she'll take
direct command from now on had me bothered...
I see. Who knows why, but the Emperor went to that plant planet...
and then went and croaked, did he?)
Bwahahahaha! Now that's a riot!
And here I was wondering how to get rid of him once Earth was conquered...
...Commander Hazard.
...!? Waaah! L-L-L-Lady Koros!?
Ahem... P-Please don't open a channel on me so suddenly.
Phew, what a scare.
Commander Hazard... Is there something you feel guilty about?
Heavens, no!
Why, I was just thinking how truly regrettable it is
that the asteroid didn't hit, yes indeed.
Then you saw that the asteroid was stopped by the Gandor Team below,
and by Londo Bell?
Y-Yes, oh, absolutely...
The Don had hoped it might succeed... but that was not to be.
We will move on to our next operation.
Go right ahead, as much as you like!
For the lovely Lady Koros and the great Lord Don Zauser,
I'll cooperate as much as you please, yes indeed!
Reassuring words, Commander Hazard. The Don will be pleased.
...We will now begin the Earth descent operation once more.
If you learn anything, be sure to report it to me.
Hail, Koros! Leave it to me, heh heh...
(The fools. Not one of them has noticed about Annex. Heh heh heh...)
...Where is this...?
The surface...! So it's true that Garalia and Show came out here?
You mean we've come out on the surface?
With this many aura ships and Aura Battlers...
I've returned to the surface!
Lord Shot, it seems that besides us, other Aura Battlers
have come out onto the surface as well...
Hmm... Most likely, all the Aura Battlers of Byston Well
have come out onto the surface.
...Lord Shot, what are your orders?
For now, we gather information on the state of things on the surface.
Is there anything I can do?
Lord Drake's Wil Wiph has most likely surfaced as well.
If you can't raise them, send out scouts if you must, but find the Wil.
As you command, Lord Shot...
Captain of the Battleship Nadesico, Yurika Misumaru,
reporting with Commander Hazuki in tow!
Commander Hazuki... Good work. And thank you, Captain Misumaru.
First time we have met in person since the last war, Captain Bright.
In any case... I'd say this battle has been settled, for now.
Long time no see, Bright.
Amuro, I see you haven't lost your touch. And... Kamille.
Sorry I worried you, Bright. I'm... fine now.
...I hear a lot happened down on the surface.
...Yes. And it's not over yet.
Kamille...
Oh, what's this? You're not burnt to a crisp. What a relief, Captain Bright.
Honestly, Pai! Oh, Bright, it's been a while.
Burnt to a crisp?
...I'm not sure what you mean, but I'm glad the Dangaioh Team is safe.
Heh, the Dangaioh sure kept bouncing back and forth, huh?
Same with the Nadesico, right?
Ahahaha, well, we kinda... went off on our own a bit, so...
It looks like Maya and the rest of you made it through, too.
We never figured we'd get shipped off to the Moon, you know.
They send us back by warp beam, and right away we're storming Jaburo.
I'm sick of it.
Captain, I'm sure there's much to discuss... but everyone is tired.
I'd like to let them rest soon, if I may?
Yes. ...But first, everyone, listen to me.
Captain Bright? ...Sounds like it's something important...
Got a bad feeling about this, anyone?
Me, me!
...Don't tell me something happened down on the surface, Captain?
That's exactly it.
Hmph. Same as always, then...
Don't tell me... the Hyakki guys are at it again...!?
No, there's been no actual damage yet, but...
I'd like the Getter Team, the Combattler Team, and you, Banjo,
to head down to the surface by HLV.
Huh? That's awful sudden...
The Getter Team got word from Dr. Saotome.
...It seems he's going to test a new Getter Reactor.
A new... Getter Reactor!?
I get it... No telling what'll happen, so he wants us back, huh?
Hmm, plus it'd be bad if the enemy attacked in the middle of that...
I get the Getter Team's part, but why us?
We smashed the Campbellian base to bits, didn't we?
That should be the case, yes...
but mechs believed to be Campbellian have been sighted on the surface.
What did you say...!?
No way, that's nuts!
They don't seem to have made any moves yet...
but Dr. Yotsuya suggested that you, who know them best, investigate.
Right... If it really is the Campbellians, it's a big problem.
Heh, I bet it's just some guys who were away from the base
sneaking around and hiding.
Whatever it is, let's hurry on over.
Now then... If I'm being called on... it means the Meganoids? Captain.
...Yes. We just confirmed a flying object descending to Earth...
and the ID code is, as you say... a Meganoid one.
Good grief. There's no rest for the weary.
We never do get a chance to see Miss Reika and the others. Ho ho ho.
Understood, Captain. I'll head down with everyone.
I'm sorry. Now that we've averted the plant planet's collision...
those who were sitting back watching will start to move.
This is the most strength we can spare... Hm... You are...
Far East Branch... Kyosuke Nanbu.
Kyosuke Nanbu... So you're him.
...About Excellen, I'm truly sorry.
If I'd been more on top of things...
No. She broke military discipline and left. That's on her.
...Any word from her since?
...She's missing. We can only roughly pin down where she vanished.
Don't worry, Kyosuke.
That lady'll be fine for sure.
Yeah, yeah, she'll come back going, "Wow! I must've dozed off!"
Yeah... Seems I've got you all worrying about me. Sorry.
Don't sweat it, we're comrades, aren't we?
That's right. We're worried about Excellen too.
They're right. Things being what they are, it'll be hard to spare
time or forces just for her, but...
I know. We'll gather whatever information on her we can.
Thank you...
...Kyosuke... Could this be about those voices...?
Yeah... I can't say they're unrelated...
Warukimedes! Dangel!
Y-Yes, my lady!
Well, well, our Empress Janera. To what do we owe the honor?
It seems the humans have caught wind
that you've secretly begun building a base on the surface.
Wh-What did you say...!? Brother, this is serious!
Warukimedes, as the one in charge of building Demon Mask Castle,
what do you intend to do?
Heh heh heh... So that is the matter.
??? Brother...?
What do you mean? Warukimedes, explain yourself.
I, Warukimedes, apologize for causing you concern, Lady Janera.
But the Earthlings catching wind of it is all part of my plan...
What, Brother!? I heard nothing about this!
It is all to lure Earth's robots to this Demon Mask Castle...
especially Combattler, which has so hindered us of planet Campbell...
right into our grasp.
So you deliberately let the humans sniff it out...?
Precisely.
They believe Oleana was Campbell's main force,
and must think we Campbellians no longer have enough strength...
So even if we reveal our presence in such a situation,
they will hardly send a large force all at once.
...I see, I get it now!
So we crush whoever they send here, one after another!
So you finally understand, it seems...
Lady Janera, with this plan, we can strike a blow against Earth's forces
with no effort at all.
As expected of Warukimedes... A splendid plan.
Hmph... Luring the enemy in bit by bit to ambush them...
What a cowardly plan, just like my brother.
Silence, Dangel!
Earth's forces are too large now for brute force like yours to handle!
No! A true warrior fights head-on, with honor!
Hold your tongue, Dangel.
...Warukimedes, first, lure Combattler to Demon Mask Castle.
Combattler...
Earth's forces are all in space now. The surface must be poorly guarded...
Just as Warukimedes intends, no large force will come.
Yes, my lady! I shall arrange to lure them out at once.
Dangel, leave the strategy to your brother. You will devote
all your strength to defeating Combattler V!
Y-Yes, my lady!
Understood? Combattler and the humans who stand in our way...
You will make a bloody sacrifice of them!!
Captain, we have an emergency transmission.
Hm, an emergency? Put it through.
It's been a while, Captain Bright.
Ronin! Is that you, Ronin!?
Been a while, Joe. Glad you made it through the plant planet business.
Well, duh! A planet or two's nothing! ...So, what's up?
Right. ...Captain Bright, the surface is in great turmoil right now.
To prevent the expected turmoil, I sent Banjo and the Getter Team
down to the surface... Is there something else?
Aura Battlers have suddenly appeared all over...!
What!? Don't tell me... the Aura Road opened again!?
Can we see footage from the surface...?
Seeing it'll be quicker, huh?
The site of the current fighting... This is Sasebo. I'll send the footage.
Fa, put it on the monitor.
Yes, Captain.
This is it... Hm? That huge shadow...?
...Looks like a battleship.
Show, Marvel! That's...!
Yes, though we can't tell which ship from this footage...
No doubt about it. It's an aura ship.
This is bad, though... It's surrounded by Aura Battlers.
Captain, are those Aura Battlers... from Drake's army!?
Right! The enemy's surfaced too! We have to get over there right now!
Then the one under attack is Lady Sheela or Lady Elle!
Show, we've gotta hurry!
Yeah, but...
Nergal has a dock in Sasebo too... Captain Bright, the Nadesico will go!
But even the Nadesico can't get there right away, can it?
There's a way to get there right away, isn't there?
A way to get there right away...?
You don't mean...
...We shouldn't rely on that too easily. The bill will come due someday.
You get it, huh? Well, we can just skip out on paying.
...So you'll just skip out.
Hm...? An emergency transmission? ...Hey, what the hell is this!?
On the monitor...!? Th-This is... a castle...!?
What a creepy place.
Gwahahahaha! Listen well, Earthlings!
You... You're a Campbellian!
Whaddaya want!?
...We've got a super-large missile aimed right at your base!
A-At the Nanbara Connection...!?
No way, out of nowhere...!
Heh heh heh... Our Empress, Lady Janera, dislikes roundabout methods.
...If you wish to stop this missile's launch, come to Demon Mask Castle,
Combattler!
Demon Mask Castle!?
I traced the signal source! ...It's in the Pacific...
That's Demon Mask Castle, our new forward base for invading Earth.
Now, what will you do...? Heh heh heh...
So it's a challenge, huh...! Fine, we'll take you on!
Hey, Hyoma! Don't just decide that on your own...
Don't lump us in with the likes of Garuda!
If you don't hurry, my finger just might slip onto the launch button!
Hahahahaha!
We'll be waiting at Demon Mask Castle, Combattler V! And Londo Bell!
Demon Mask Castle will be your grave!
...I did say to contact me when you needed my power...
but I didn't think it'd be this soon.
My apologies.
I know what you want.
There's a commotion in a town... Sasebo, was it?
And you want me to warp you there, eh?
You catch on quick, don't you? ...I like that kind of person.
Oho? Don't I just, don't I just! Nuhahaha!
He's so easy to flatter...
There are plenty of people like that on the Nadesico too.
Warp beam... I'd love to study how it differs from Boson Jump in detail.
Why not, if he lets us take data? It might come in handy.
(That doc's kinda like Hazard, too, in how I can't quite trust him.)
Ahem. Doctor, I'm sorry, but... we must borrow your power once more.
So, what about the people besides us who boarded the Nadesico?
Neo Zeon, the Vega Star Federation, and others...
With the plant planet crisis over, they could make a move anytime.
The members who stay here will keep them in check.
Even so, most of Londo Bell and the Gandor Team have come over here...
I'll have to recalculate the costs for the mess hall and hot springs.
The Elshank will accompany you as well, but...
for comfort, I believe the ships of you Earth folk are better...
Whoa, the Nadesico's got something that good on board!?
Boss, let's go take a dip later!
You bet! Guhuhuhu...
Koji, Boss! You're not thinking anything funny, are you...?
C-Come on, Sayaka, no way, nothing like that! Right, Boss?
O-Of course not!
Koji's turning all red. Weird.
...The Londo Bell people seem like they'd fit right in on the Nadesico...
Well, we're the Federation, but we've got plenty of civilian helpers...
Hot springs, you say... That brings back memories, Shiro...
Y-Yeah... I-I guess it does...
Lady Aina...?
So: the Umon siblings, Judau's group, the Dangaioh Team, Rom's group,
Seabook and Cecily, and Kasshu's group will stay here.
I'm counting on you for the surface.
Surprised Rain's coming over here.
I had to go pick up Kyoji, who stayed behind at Jaburo...
And besides, Domon and Allenby...
Hm?
Sounds kinda delicate, huh?
Now, now, don't be tactless.
Don't be crude... crude oil... ...I'm off my game...
Oh, Izumi, are you ever on your game?
Curses...
So, command of the surface force goes to... Captain Misumaru?
Huh!?
Command on the ground will be left to Commander Hazuki.
Please take charge of the operations on Earth.
Understood. Sorry to step on your toes, Captain. I'm counting on you.
Not at all! The Cyber Beast-style command they never taught in class,
I'll learn it from you firsthand, Commander! Umm,
"All right! Charge! Let's do this!"
...Fujiwara.
Why's that my fault!?
Idiot...
Geez! This is no time for chitchat!
If we don't hurry, Lady Sheela or Lady Elle...
Cham, calm down. The deck's still being prepped. Panicking won't help.
In that footage, I also saw Aura Battlers fighting Drake's army.
That should buy some time.
Well, the girl's right. Hurry up and get ready, would you?
If I stick around too long, the Bunker might find me.
If that happens, Doc, we'll come save you.
That's right. Don't worry.
You kids... You're that worried about me...?
Until you get everyone down to the surface, anyway.
Honestly, Pai!
Sigh... Still won't come back to me, eh... Fine, see if I care!
Well then, Captain Bright.
The Battleship Nadesico is departing for the Sasebo defense operation!
